Name: StarJewMod
Author: nikimouse221
Description:
This mod adds a few jewish decor items, like a Hanukkia and a Khamsa to the game. (can be obtained from the furniture catalogue) 
It also adds food that your farmer will know by default and you will be able to cook as soon as you get a kitchen!
It also adds a wearable Kippa that can be purchased from the hat mouse once you unlock him.
*please note that the kippa does not have a sprite when in the toolbar! that is because it is not visible when the farmer is facing forward. You can hover above the "empty" slot and view the description, and once you put it on the farmer it will show up from the side and back views.
